meta.title: Laguna de Bay water quality, July 2025 to June 2026
meta.source: Laguna Lake Development Authority quarterly water quality reports, Q3 2025 to Q2 2026
meta.valueType: Monthly value. Fecal coliform is a geometric mean.
meta.standard: DENR Administrative Order No. 34 (1990), Class C waters
meta.coordinateNote: Positions were fitted from the station map printed in each report, georeferenced against the OpenStreetMap lake boundary (about 43 m per pixel).

parameters.label: Dissolved Oxygen
parameters.note: Oxygen available to fish. Low values mean organic waste is being broken down.

parameters.label: Biochemical Oxygen Demand
parameters.note: Organic pollution, mostly from household sewage.

parameters.label: pH
parameters.note: Acidity or alkalinity of the water.

parameters.label: Nitrate
parameters.note: Nutrient from fertiliser, sewage and livestock.

parameters.label: Ammonia
parameters.note: Fresh sewage and animal waste indicator. No Class C limit.

parameters.label: Total Suspended Solids
parameters.note: Solid particles carried in the water.

parameters.label: Chloride
parameters.note: Salt content; rises with saltwater backflow and wastewater.

parameters.label: Fecal Coliform
parameters.note: Bacteria from human or animal faeces. No Class C limit.
